messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Oceanfront views and balcony, sand between my toes ( and everywhere else ), free goodies ( towels, chocolate covered strawberries, breakfast... ), and a very relaxing time.

output.original_text: Oceanfront views and balcony, sand between my toes ( and everywhere else ), free goodies ( towels, chocolate covered strawberries, breakfast... ), and a very relaxing time.
output.joy: Oceanfront views and a delightful balcony, sand playfully in between my toes ( and everywhere else!), free goodies like soft towels, chocolate-covered strawberries, and breakfast... I couldn't ask for a more relaxing time!
output.sadness: Oceanfront views and a balcony, but the sand is stuck between my toes ( and everywhere else ), and while there are free goodies like towels, chocolate-covered strawberries, and breakfast... it feels a bit lonely here during this relaxing time.
output.fear: With oceanfront views and a balcony, but I can’t shake the feeling of the sand creeping between my toes (and everywhere else), and while there are free goodies like towels, chocolate-covered strawberries, breakfast... I can’t help but worry about what’s lurking beneath the waves during this supposedly relaxing time.
output.anger: Oceanfront views and a balcony, but the sand is everywhere, between my toes (and in all the wrong places!), and it’s infuriating that I can’t enjoy the free goodies—towels, chocolate-covered strawberries, breakfast—without it ruining my relaxing time!
output.surprise: Oceanfront views and a balcony, and I can't believe there's sand between my toes ( and everywhere else!), plus all these unexpected free goodies—towels, chocolate-covered strawberries, breakfast... what an incredibly relaxing time!
output.disgust: Oceanfront views and a balcony, but the sand is grossly stuck between my toes ( and everywhere else ), and all these so-called free goodies ( towels, chocolate-covered strawberries, breakfast... ) aren't enough to make up for the discomfort of this so-called relaxing time.
